Updates:

  • Still exploring two potential pathways: Augmenting Balance (GVS) and Technical Minimalism
  • Tech Min = technically saturated, not a lot of opportunities
  • GVS = need special, expensive equipment
  • Prefers to focus on a physical device
  • young people aren't in thought - where are the moments of boredom that once existed but have disappeared now? 
  • Default Mode Network

Feedback:

  • Consider what it would require to make an open-source medical device
  • What does it mean to be "bored"? 
  • GVS pathway may be over-constrained at the moment and difficult to validate - but could look into specific resources and experts early
  • Could look more broadly into open-sourcing med tech. in general (pivot from GVS)
  • Don't purse a defined "device" right now - trust your own research process to guide you to a device
  • can you concretely put to words what you're trying to achieve? this will lead to good questions and understanding of problems in achieving this state? 
  • Look at historic trends in behavior - when/where were people bored in the past? 
  • What about some of mental conditions (i.e. depression, schizophrenia, etc) that stem from issues of the Default Mode Network
